text:
Priya Shah: Heads up — I noticed a ~$48k variance between the revenue schedule and GL deferred balance for Contract C-9812 (ACME-EU) in the May close. Can someone confirm what ran last night?
Marco Diaz: which ledger/journal are you comparing?
Priya Shah: revenue_schedule (schedule export) shows $120,000 deferred for May, AR balance / deferred GL shows $72,000. So deferred is short by ~$48k.
Elena Wu: could be a reversing JE or unapplied credit. I'll run the schedule vs AR reconciliation now.
Elena Wu: running quick SQL to pull schedule + posted JEs: ```SELECT contract_id, period, sum(amount) AS scheduled_deferral FROM revenue_schedule WHERE contract_id = 'C-9812' AND period = '2026-05' GROUP BY contract_id, period; SELECT je_id, posted_date, line_account, amount FROM journal_lines WHERE memo LIKE '%C-9812%' AND posted_date BETWEEN '2026-05-30' AND '2026-05-31';```
Jules: queued — checking AR / invoice adjustments.
acct-bot: Journal JRN-4543 posted by @Marco Diaz on 2026-05-31 22:17 UTC. Lines: Debit Revenue 72,000; Credit Deferred Revenue 72,000.
Marco Diaz: I posted a reversal for a duplicate invoice INV-1009 — looks like the JE I used hit Revenue instead of AR. That might explain the shortfall.
Priya Shah: Ok — if the JE reduced deferred by 72k and reduced revenue, that would drop the deferred balance. We need to move the 72k back into deferred. Can you confirm the exact JE lines and proposed correction?
Marco Diaz: mistaken JE (JRN-4543):
```
JRN-4543
DR Revenue 72,000
CR Deferred Revenue 72,000
```
Proposed correcting JE (draft):
```
JRN-REV-4543-CORR
DR Deferred Revenue 72,000
CR Revenue 72,000
Memo: Reclassify reversal posted to Revenue instead of AR for INV-1009 (C-9812)
```
Elena Wu: That correction will reclassify recognition back to deferred — good. Two quick asks before we post: 1) confirm customer-facing invoice status (was INV-1009 actually issued/voided?), 2) provide audit trail note for the month close.
Marco Diaz: INV-1009 was duplicate and we intended to void; original AR credit should have been: DR AR 72,000; CR Deferred Revenue 72,000. Instead I reversed revenue. I can post the correcting reclass JE plus a separate AR adjustment if needed.
Priya Shah: Please do both: post the correcting reclass JE and the AR credit/adjustment. Add a memo referencing INV-1009 and include the original invoice id. Attach supporting docs to month-close folder.
Elena Wu: I'll review and approve the reclass once you upload the JE and support. @Jules — can you confirm any impact on revenue recognition reports we push to accounting upstream?
Jules: Will validate the recognition feed. If we post the correcting JE before EOD close runs, reports should re-sync cleanly. Otherwise we'll need a restatement entry for recognized revenue.
Priya Shah: timeline — need this in before 18:00 PT to avoid restatement. Marco, can you target 16:30 PT for upload so we have buffer? :clock3:
Marco Diaz: yes will upload by 16:00 PT and ping when done.
acct-bot: File uploaded to /finance/month-close/2026-05/attachments/JRN-REV-4543-CORR.pdf by Marco Diaz at 2026-05-31 15:58 UTC.
Elena Wu: Reviewed the JE and support — approved. :white_check_mark: Marco, go ahead to post and notify when posted.
Marco Diaz: Posted correcting JE JRN-REV-4543-CORR at 2026-05-31 16:12 UTC. Posted AR adjustment INV-1009-CREDIT at 16:15 UTC. Notifying downstream reports.
Priya Shah: Verified deferred GL now matches schedule for C-9812; variance cleared. Thanks team — leaving note in month close checklist and tagging for audit. :thumbsup:
Jules: I'll run final recognition feed and confirm clean.
Priya Shah: Closing thread — tag me if anything else pops up.
